state_code: # STATUS: ADOPTED, NOT YET IN EFFECT. North Carolina 2026 K-12 Mathematics Standard Course of Study ("Draft 3"), K-5 objectives.
# - Approved by the State Board of Education on 1 October 2026 (agenda item SSE 3, for Action; recommendation: approve the standards and Extended
#   Content Standards as submitted). Vote reported by WRAL 2026-10-01 ("without opposition"); no SBE minutes for 1 Oct 2026 posted as of 2026-10-02.
# - Draft 3 was first presented for discussion at the 2-3 September 2026 meeting. Timeline (NCDPI slides, FAQ): installation 2026-27 and 2027-28,
#   in classrooms and state tests from 2028-29 (tentative). The 2017 NC SCOS (nc.tsv) stays in effect until then.
# - SBE meeting 2026-10-01, agenda (item SSE 3 "Standards to Students: K-12 Mathematics Standards Draft 3"):
#   https://simbli.eboardsolutions.com/SB_Meetings/ViewMeeting.aspx?S=10399&MID=19087&Tab=Agenda  (Incapsula blocks scripts; read in a browser)
# - Standards: "Copy of Draft 3 - K-12 Math Standards for SBE (1)", 105-page PDF, pages dated "September, 2026", watermarked DRAFT:
# - NCDPI crosswalk: "Copy of Draft 3 2026 NCSCOS K- 12 Math Crosswalks (2)", 221-page PDF (K-8 grade crosswalks, 2026 objective -> 2017 NC standard or "New"):
# - Also attached: Data Report Review of Draft 2 (AID=487704), K-12 ECS Math Proposed 2026 (AID=487707), OCS Introduction to Math (AID=487708).
# - NCDPI bulletin 2026-09-04 (Draft 3 to SBE in September, action expected October): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/NCSBE/bulletins/4286d21
# - dpi.nc.gov's mathematics pages still list only the 2017 SCOS (checked 2026-10-02); the adopted text is not yet posted there.
# - CCSS baseline: https://corestandards.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/Math_Standards1.pdf ; 2017 NC -> CCSS through nc.tsv in this folder.
# - Grade.Domain.Standard.Objective, e.g. K.ANR.2.3 = kindergarten, Algebraic and Numerical Reasoning, standard 2, objective 3. No "NC." prefix
#   (2017 codes had one). Standards are numbered from 1 within each grade's domain; objectives from 1 within each standard. Rows are objectives.
# - K-5 domains (same three every grade): ANR Algebraic and Numerical Reasoning; SGMR Spatial, Geometric, and Measurement Reasoning;
#   RD Reasoning with Data. (Grades 6-7 add RPR, Ratio and Proportional Reasoning; grade 8 codes use ANFR.)
# - Sub-bullets (problem types, strategy lists) belong to their objective. The four Mathematical and Statistical Practices carry no codes; skipped.
# - K-5: 76 standards, 322 objectives. K 12/48, grade 1 16/52, grade 2 14/48, grade 3 11/58, grade 4 12/64, grade 5 11/52 (standards/objectives).
# KINDS (judgement against the CCSS K-5 text; counts)

# - By grade: K 48 (28 same, 10 edited, 1 moved, 9 new); 1 52 (30 same, 13 edited, 7 moved, 2 new); 2 48 (28 same, 13 edited, 6 moved, 1 new); 3 58 (32 same, 15 edited, 9 moved, 2 new); 4 64 (20 same, 33 edited, 8 moved, 3 new); 5 52 (15 same, 32 edited, 4 moved, 1 new).
# - same = carries one CCSS standard (or a faithful part of one; splits count as same) with no change in substance.
#   edited = CCSS content at the same grade with changed range, scope or added parts (other-grade codes may be listed too).
#   moved = the content is CCSS at another K-5 grade (that grade's code is in ccss). new = no CCSS K-5 content (including grade 6+ content).
# - ccss: started from NCDPI's crosswalk (2026 objective -> 2017 NC standard -> CCSS via nc.tsv), then narrowed to the CCSS standard(s) the
#   objective's own text carries (e.g. 4.SGMR.1.x split over 4.MD.C.5/6/7 instead of all three). Codes outside K-5 are never listed.
# - NCDPI marks 55 K-5 objectives "New" relative to 2017 NC: 44 plain "New" and 11 "New Content Incorporated from NC.x" (another grade).
# - Paired with a 2017 standard by NCDPI but moved against CCSS: 1.SGMR.6.1-6.2 (coins), 4.SGMR.3.2-3.5 (metric), 4.SGMR.4.2-4.3, 5.ANR.3.4.
# - Not marked New by NCDPI but new against CCSS: K.ANR.1.8 and K.ANR.4.1 (subitizing; NC already had it in 2017).
# CCSS K-5 STANDARDS NO ROW CARRIES
# - K.G.A.1 (position words), 2.G.A.2 (rows and columns of squares), 2.MD.B.5 (length word problems), 2.MD.D.9 (line plot of lengths).
# - Rounding is never named: 3.NBT.A.1, 4.NBT.A.3 and 5.NBT.A.4 (rounding decimals) have no row of their own; the estimation rows
#   (3.ANR.6.2, 4.ANR.4.2, 5.ANR.4.5) may use rounding but do not say so. 5.NBT.A.4 is listed nowhere here either.
# - Partly dropped: 5.NBT.B.6 two-digit divisors (grade 5 divides by one digit only); 5.NBT.B.7 decimal x decimal (only whole number up to 4
#   times or divided with a decimal); 5.NBT.A.2 exponents; 5.OA.A.1 brackets and braces; 4.NBT.B.5 four-digit by one-digit (three-digit kept);
#   4.MD.B.4 and 5.MD.B.2 fraction line plots; 4.MD.A.1 customary conversions (grade 5 converts customary); 3.MD.A.2 grams/kilograms/liters
#   (grade 3 is customary; metric goes to grade 4); 2.NBT.B.6 four addends (three kept); 2.MD.B.6 number line moved to grade 1 (1.ANR.4.1).
# - New: subitizing (K.ANR.1.8, K.ANR.4.1); counting back (K.ANR.2.3 within 10, 1.ANR.1.2 within 120); repeating patterns (K.ANR.7.x);
#   estimating on a number line (1.ANR.4.3, 2.ANR.3.2); the data cycle from K (posing questions, collecting) and predicting from data
#   (3.RD.1.7, 4.RD.1.9, 5.RD.1.7); range, mode, median in grade 4 (4.RD.1.6-1.7, from 6.SP); equal-or-not reasoning for x and / (3.ANR.5.3).
# - Earlier than CCSS: skip counting by 5s and coins in grade 1; number line in grade 1; composing shapes and symmetry in grade 2; time to
#   the minute in grade 2; place value to 10,000 in grade 3; lines, segments, parallel/perpendicular and angle types in grade 3.
# - Later than CCSS: metric measuring and area of rectilinear figures in grade 4; full x facts by heart in grade 4 (grade 3 recalls 0,1,2,5,10s);
#   whole-number place value to 1,000,000 in grade 5; interpreting remainders and multistep whole-number problems in grade 5.
# - Narrowed ranges: K compares to 20 (CCSS 10); grade 4 whole numbers to 100,000; factor pairs to 50; fraction work limited to related
#   denominators (4.ANR.5.4, 5.ANR.5.1-5.2); triangles classified by sides too (4.SGMR.2.x).
# - The adopted text is the Draft 3 PDF attached to the action item (still marked DRAFT, footer "September, 2026"); a clean final edition may
#   follow on dpi.nc.gov. The vote itself is from news and the agenda; minutes are not posted yet.
# - NCDPI's crosswalk is labelled DRAFT and "an initial comparison" against 2017 NC, not CCSS; it has typos ("NC.4.NBT. 7", "NC.5.G.3Classify").
# - Data-cycle rows: posing, planning, collecting and communicating are edited (CCSS grade data standard extended) where NCDPI pairs them with
#   a 2017 data standard (grades 1-5), new in K where NCDPI marks them New. Sorting in grade 2 marked moved (K.MD.B.3, 1.MD.C.4).
# - 5.ANR.3.2-3.3 (four-digit by one-digit, long division) kept as edited 5.NBT.B.6 although the range is CCSS grade 4's (4.NBT.B.6);
#   NCDPI says 5.ANR.3.3 takes the algorithm from NC.6.NS.2 (CCSS 6.NS.B.2).
# - 2.SGMR.1.2-1.3 NCDPI says "incorporated from NC.3.G.1"; the CCSS content (composing/decomposing shapes) is 1.G.A.2, so moved from grade 1.
# - 4.SGMR.3.3-3.5 (measure in cm, m, l, ml, g, kg) marked moved (2.MD.A.1, 3.MD.A.2); 4.SGMR.3.6-3.7 edited (4.MD.A.1-2).
